<template>
  <div>{{ pick(flag, "a", "b") }}</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

const flag = ref(true);

function pick(flag: boolean, x: string, y: string): string {
  return flag ? x : y;
}

const loopSum = (items: number[]): number => {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (items[i] % 2 === 0) {
      total += items[i];
    }
  }
  return total;
};

function describe(kind: string): string {
  switch (kind) {
    case "a":
      return "alpha";
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

function safeDivide(a: number, b: number): number {
  try {
    return a / b;
  } catch (e) {
    return 0;
  }
}

function elseifKeyword(n: number): string {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  } elseif (n === 0) {
    return "zero";
  }
  return "positive";
}
</script>
